title.narrative: El nino Anticipatory Flood Response for Protection of Marginalized and Minority Communities in Beletweyne and Jowhar districts, Hirshabelle, Somalia.

description.narrative:
ltpgtltspan style="font-family:"gtThe project aims at strengthening Protection of the displaced and non displaced Marginalized and Minority Communities in Beletweyne and Jowhar Districts, Hirshabelle, Somalia" through a comprehensive integrated approach designed to proactively address the impending threat of El Niño-induced flooding in the Hirshabelle region with a specific focus on safeguarding the marginalized and minority communities residing in Beletweyne and Jowhar Districts.
